text: Start: tracker card delete + lane change (!p1). Reading tracker.html and /api/todo-update.

Done. 'Type' = the LANE (the ## section), the only one of a card's four attributes with no UI. Lane badge is now a button: pick a lane, the card's whole block moves. Delete is an x by the pencil, behind a confirm, with 25s Undo that restores the card whole, plus .tracker/deleted-cards.jsonl as a permanent trash log. Both keep the stale-text guard. New suite tests/features/tracker-delete-and-retype.test.mjs on port 4357, proved red against 11 mutants incl. 'skip the guard for delete' and 'join with CRLF'.

Handed back. Files: .tracker/tracker.html, scripts/preview-server.mjs (/api/todo-update gains remove/toLane/restore), tests/features/tracker-delete-and-retype.test.mjs, .agents/agents.md. Notes and the mutation harness in .tmp/scratch/opus5-35/. Regression: preview-todo-update-endpoint and tracker-scroll-and-ids both green, real todo.md still 0 CRLF. Port 4311 released.
